findings.location: …She would be able to help along with this song!
findings.source_quote: She would be able to help along with this song!
findings.suggested_fix: Render the thought in third-person narrative perspective consistent with the English original (Ellie's internal thought reported by narrator). For example: «Ela seria capaz de ajudar com este hino!» or keep third-person: «Ela poderia ajudar com este canto!»

findings.location: “Let’s sing number 8 in the Appendix,” announced the song leader. Ellie’s heart sang. They were going to sing her favorite song.
findings.source_quote: They were going to sing her favorite song.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the Portuguese grammar/tense. Replace the current wording with a standard, grammatical rendering such as: «Iriam cantar seu hino preferido.» or more naturally: «Viriam a cantar seu hino preferido.» or «Vão cantar seu hino preferido.» — pick one consistent tense (past narrative would be «iriam» or «foram girar» is wrong; recommended: «Viriam a cantar seu hino preferido.» or simply «Irão cantar» is nonstandard; best: «Viriam a cantar seu hino preferido.» or «Vão cantar o seu hino preferido.» depending on preferred narrative tense.
findings.translation_quote: O coração de Ellie cantou. Irão cantar seu hino preferido.
